el.Escribo canciones desde lo que viví y me: I write songs from what I've lived and what has changed me. First I live it, then I understand it, and only then does it become a song.
el.ADN habla de mis raíces y de mi identida: ADN speaks of my roots and my identity, of everything that makes me who I am. I carry my grandfather with me everywhere, and so does this song.
el.Soy cantante y compositora. Escribir fue: I'm a singer and songwriter. Writing has always been how I express what I feel: I have to live things first, then understand them, and only then do they become a song.
el.Rompecabezas es una de mis verdades, y l: Rompecabezas is one of my truths, and the rest are on their way.
el.Reconstruirme no es volver a ser quien e: Rebuilding myself doesn't mean becoming who I was again, but recognizing myself in everything that changed.
